_doc: Hand-entered ship data, merged into ships.json by build_reference.py. `fleet`: the player's ships (CLAUDE.md section 11, the fleet as of 2026-11-23) by vehicle class, with the one job each stands for in the dashboard's view rules: mining, salvage, cargo or combat; null for a ship with two jobs or none (it decides no view). A class the installed build does not have stops the run. `ships`: field-level overrides of generated ship entries (none so far).

ANVL_Liberator.note: Mothership and home base; carries the others.

RSI_Perseus.note: Role not stated yet (CIG: heavy gunship); no pilot guns.

DRAK_Ironclad_Assault.note: Role not stated yet (CIG: heavy dropship).

GAMA_Hyun.note: Mines and salvages: two jobs, so it decides no view.

RSI_Ursa_Medivac.note: Ground vehicle, driven on the Xbox controller.
